title: Marvin Harrison Jr. says Jim Harbaugh's defenses focus on him, in college and the NFL

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. says Jim Harbaugh's defenses focus on him, in college and the NFL
sources.description: Cardinals wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr. caught only one pass in his team's win over the Chargers on Sunday, which Harrison says was a result of Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh focusing the defense on shutting him down.
